preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= n for n, perm in zip(test_cases, permutations) for x in perm.split())
preconditions.description: Each permutation contains integers between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(len(perm.split()) == n for n, perm in zip(test_cases, permutations))
preconditions.description: Each permutation has exactly n integers.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(perm.split())) == n for n, perm in zip(test_cases, permutations))

postconditions.expression: all(stdout_lines[i] == 'ambiguous' if permutation == inverse_permutation else stdout_lines[i] == 'not ambiguous' for i, (permutation, inverse_permutation) in enumerate(zip(permutations, inverse_permutations)))
postconditions.description: The output is 'ambiguous' if the permutation is the same as its inverse permutation, otherwise 'not ambiguous'.
